extracted text: The paper investigates the fatigue behavior of AA7075 aluminum alloy severely deformed by equal channel angular pressing (ECAP). The specimens were heat treated in two different conditions: annealed at 688 K for 2 h followed by furnace cooling (annealed specimens (O)) and solution treated at 743 K for 2 h and water quenched (super-saturated solid solution specimens (SSS)). The annealed specimens were subjected to ECAP process up to 4 passes, while SSS samples were pressed just 1 pass. The 1 pass ECAPed SSS samples were aged at 393 K for 15 h (post-ECAP aging). Table 2 provides the mechanical properties of both annealed and solution treated specimens before and after ECAP process. T6 condition is also mentioned as a comparison.
